probes.question: What did the first SMS message say?
True or false: the first SMS was sent from a personal computer to a phone.

image.alt: Flat illustration of a chunky early mobile phone with an antenna, a speech bubble on its screen and radio waves beside it.

panels.text: On 3 December 1992, a test engineer named Neil Papworth sends a message to a colleague's phone.
He works for Sema Group. The message goes over the Vodafone GSM network in the United Kingdom, from a personal computer to an Orbitel 901 handset.
It reaches Richard Jarvis, who works for Vodafone. The text of the message: "Merry Christmas."
It is the first SMS message sent. The first commercial short message service center followed in Sweden in 1993.
